items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And the only way we found it out was a man that Tootie had a fine dinner service

ctx.x: And the only way we found it out was a man that Tootie had a fine dinner service, and he, you know, he needed this -- he'd go down to the store and buy nutmeg just to have it, buy supplies anyway, and the man out of the grocery store said, 'You sure must be cooking lots of cakes and pies.' And he said, why? And he said, you get some of the colored guys coming down here," he said, "they buying up all my nutmeg."
